func TestDeleteMemoStore(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	ctx := context.Background()
	ts := NewTestingStore(ctx, t)
	user, err := createTestingHostUser(ctx, ts)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	memoCreate := &store.Memo{
		UID:        "test-resource-name",
		CreatorID:  user.ID,
		Content:    "test_content",
		Visibility: store.Public,
	}
	memo, err := ts.CreateMemo(ctx, memoCreate)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, memoCreate.Content, memo.Content)
	err = ts.DeleteMemo(ctx, &store.DeleteMemo{
		ID: memo.ID,
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	ts.Close()
}

Checking the `DeleteMemo` function in `/bench/repo/store/memo.go` to identify which related records are deleted before the memo row itself.

The store layer deletes `memo_relation` and `attachment` records before the memo row itself. Child memo rows are deleted by the API before calling `DeleteMemo`, but these are memo rows rather than other record types.

Recursive `DeleteMemo` calls also delete relations and attachments for child comments. Reactions, inbox items, and memo shares are not deleted by `store.DeleteMemo`.

The API layer deletes child comment memos before the main memo row itself.
